content:
ajohnson: Flagging a ~9% mismatch between vendor token export and our billing ledger for promo tenants. Vendor totals are higher. Suspect replay/ratecap double-apportionment.

maria-ops: can you paste a redacted vendor row?

ajohnson: sample: ```customer_id,window_start,ingest_tokens,ratecap_apportioned
ACME-123,2026-02-01T00:00Z,120000,132000
PLAT-42,2026-02-01T00:00Z,80000,88000```

liam: which export pipeline did vendor run (dedupe-v3 vs nightly)?

ajohnson: vendor claims dedupe-v3. ledger disagrees. opening vendor ticket now.

maria-ops: @finance-bot run quick totals: internal vs vendor for window '2026-02-01' tag 'promo-2026-02'.

finance-bot: Done. totals -> internal=1200000, vendor=1320000. Top deltas: ACME-123 +12k, PLAT-42 +8k. Most delta rows have header flags `x-proxy-replay:true`.

sara: Invoice run Tue  do we hold?

liam: hold until root cause. If it's our bug we absorb; if vendor miscount, request credit.

ajohnson: vendor ticket #VND-4521 created and includes sample rows + contract clause: "Replay events for delivery guarantees shall not be billable." Vendor SLA 48h.

maria-ops: action list: 1) ajohnson: vendor ticket + event ids; 2) sara: hold invoices < $5k for affected tenants; 3) liam: audit ratecap_apportioner for retry double-count and add telemetry/dedupe.

sara: approve auto-hold <=$5k. Pre-approve credits <=$2k for promo customers; >$2k needs manager sign-off. I'll prepare a credit memo template.

liam: quick code note: `billing/allocators/ratecap_apportioner.go` has a retry-related TODO. I'll add a one-off tracer to correlate `replay_id` across edge -> billing -> vendor export. ETA EOD.

ajohnson: will update thread with vendor response. If vendor concedes, we'll run retro credits and follow the approval thresholds above. :thumbsup:
